description: This is a Python source file defining a function to build a research graph workflow using various agents and a state graph, as well as a main script to execute it with command line arguments. It orchestrates multiple agent initializations, state transitions, and control flow for a research automation process.

classes.name: ResearchState
classes.description: A data schema representing the state of research process, supporting retrieval of state variables.

classes.name: StateGraph
classes.description: Represents a state machine to orchestrate workflow steps, allowing addition of nodes and conditional edges.

methods.name: build_research_graph(serper_api_key: str = SERPER_API_KEY, openai_api_key: str = OPENAI_API_KEY, confidence_threshold: float = CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD, max_retries: int = MAX_RETRIES, add_max_results: int = ADD_MAX_RESULTS)
methods.description: Constructs and configures a state graph workflow for conducting research using various AI agents, with conditional transitions based on state outcomes.

methods.name: str on_search_complete(state: ResearchState)
methods.description: Determines next state after search completes, directing to either stop or summarize.

methods.name: str on_summarization_complete(state: ResearchState)
methods.description: Determines next state after summarization, either stopping or proceeding to fact checking.

methods.name: str on_fact_check_complete(state: ResearchState)
methods.description: Decides whether to continue, retry, or stop based on fact checking confidence and errors.

methods.name: str on_report_complete(state: ResearchState)
methods.description: Determines whether to terminate after report generation.

methods.name: str on_stop_workflow(_state: ResearchState)
methods.description: Defines behavior when stopping the workflow.
